reserveReview.rationale: At finalized Ethereum block 26471538, hash 0x0ed7ff86e140f8da55c14e9ee58a6370dfa17efeaeb7eb8e0b4c6086869979e9, timestamp 2026-11-22T15:25:11Z (read via keyless endpoint https://eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2/), the complete current census contains 21 authorized markets. The prior 18-market baseline at block 26236645 ($5,036,355.30149916) was independently reproduced within floating-point precision (max constituent diff 5.33e-15 percentage points). A full numeric-range delta scan from block 26236645 through 26471538 (plus full-history confirmation from block 24570211) recovers exactly three additional StakeDao Vault factory registrations: frxUSD/crvUSD (0xe1065be419cacaf05477ea77a32cb33e8bcbc7da, block 26284662), crvUSD/ETH/CRV (0xb4edf0dd81b2ad31703b61da098401d0c83607bf, block 26393392), and PYUSD/crvUSD (0xf9fbb128d4569bfc6f97124e13ae32cd6fb6a48b, block 26442041), with zero intervening ControlTower events, zero former-MarketCreator events, and zero USG role events (SetIsMinter, SetIsBurner, SetIsIRProducer, SetIsPegKeeper, OwnershipTransferred). All 21 markets return isMinter=true at block 26471538. Same-block collatToken(), collatOracle(), totalCollateral(), collatDecimals(), and oracle latestAnswer(true) measure $3,274,560.92411909 of protocol-oracle-marked borrower collateral. Each market mark is allocated using its pool's verified native normalized-balance accounting: balance times stored_rates() for seventeen CurveStableSwapNG pools, fixed decimal multipliers for two legacy pools (msETH/WETH and USDT/crvUSD), price_scale() for the WETH/CVX 2-coin crypto pool, and precisions() with price_scale(0..1) for the crvUSD/WETH/CRV tricrypto pool. All 22 measured constituents are explicit and sum to 100%; fifteen exact Ethereum contract matches establish tracked stablecoin collateral dependencies, while seven non-stablecoin instruments (msETH, WETH, CVX, cbBTC, WBTC, CRV, and OETH) remain untracked cryptoasset exposures with matching non-link dispositions. Both registered PegKeepers (0xf89615f75c8161dc185c03020240905f6b66bad9 and 0x8a7f16508d1e8b48bdf36023f378cc04d9506d4e) hold 1,500,000 prefunded USG each (3,000,000 USG total, down from 20,000,000 each at block 26236645) and both report debt()=0, so these self-token inventories remain excluded; USG totalSupply is 5,605,854.67213403 USG (2,605,854.67213403 USG outside PegKeepers), sum of market debt is 2,606,203.11172069 USG, IRCalculator.mintableInterests() is 348.43958666 USG (3,591 wei truncation difference), and badDebt() is zero on all 21 markets. This collateral observation does not certify whole-liability financial reconciliation, funded redemption, custody protections, or stressed realization.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Complete current 21-market borrower-collateral census and deployed oracle marks at finalized Ethereum block 26471538; exact LP constituent attribution by same-block native pool accounting. Prefunded PegKeeper USG remains excluded.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete 21-market collateral book is identified at the 2026-11-22 pin. Whole-position stressed realization, custody protections of underlying instruments, and complete native-supply financial reconciliation remain unestablished; none is inferred from LP balance/rate accounting.
